No other page, memory entry, or session log should store status for any surface listed here. *Last audited: 2026-05-05 — PR1 (SQS deletion, commits 6e71d7d → ae338fb on **`main`**) shipped 2026-05-05. Affected surfaces include: Official MCP Registry, Glama, Smithery, *[*mcp.so*](http://mcp.so)*, npm strale-mcp (tool descriptions), npm straleio + PyPI straleio (type contracts), the 6 framework plugins (langchain-strale, crewai-strale, openai-agents-strale, google-adk-strale, pydantic-ai-strale, strale-semantic-kernel), *[*strale.dev/llms.txt*](http://strale.dev/llms.txt)*, MCP tool descriptions, *[*CLAUDE.md*](http://CLAUDE.md)* canonical snippet, Cursor/Windsurf rules, GitHub Gists. Description rewrites and SDK version bumps are tracked as a separate To-do, not yet scheduled. Per-surface status updates will follow when each is re-verified. Per DEC-20260503-A/B and the SQS deletion DEC chain (DEC-20260503-B → DEC-20260505-A/B/C). Previously: 2026-04-06.* *2026-05-07 audit — DE OpenRegister activation (PR #59 commit 3d62a4b) and Gap-7 reclassification (DEC-20260507-A) audited against this registry. No per-surface updates required: country-active count derives dynamically from DB (auto-updates on deploy), capability count unchanged (**`german-company-data`** was previously deactivated, now reactivated — no net add to inventory), MCP tool descriptions and llms.txt are generic (no per-country coverage references). Pre-existing SQS-era language refresh from 2026-05-05 audit is still pending and tracked separately.* > ⚠️ **Stack Overflow — PAUSED (2026-03-29).** First Q&A (KYB) posted and live. Moderator warning received same day for promotional posting. Approach paused — account needs organic rep (50+ from unrelated answers) before more Strale-related Q&As. Live post: [https://stackoverflow.com/questions/79916596](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/79916596) --- ## Governance rules > **Rule 1 — One source.** Status for any distribution surface lives here and nowhere else. If it's in a session log, move it here and delete it there. > **Rule 2 — Update on change.** Whenever a surface status changes, update this page the same day. Include the date and what changed. > **Rule 3 — Claude Code prompts must close the loop.** Any CC prompt that affects a surface listed here must include a final step to update this page. > **Rule 4 — Claude (chat) reads this page, not memory.** Distribution surface status is never stored in Claude's memory. > **Rule 5 — Audit before action.** Before changing anything on a surface, read what currently exists and confirm the change is an improvement. --- ## Status legend
Symbol Meaning
✅ Live Confirmed live, no known issues
⚠️ Degraded Live but with a known problem
🔄 Pending Submitted, awaiting review/merge/approval
❌ Blocked Submission attempted but rejected or broken
🔲 Not started Identified surface, not yet submitted
🔍 Unverified Not independently confirmed

Salesforce AgentExchange ([agentexchange.salesforce.com](https://agentexchange.salesforce.com/collections/agentforce-mcp)) 🔲 Not started 2026-04-02 **Status: Monitoring / future.** Salesforce's curated MCP marketplace for Agentforce agents. \~35 launch partners (AWS, Stripe, PayPal, IBM, Notion, etc.). Agentforce has native MCP client (GA July 2025), enterprise-grade MCP server registry, and agent gateway that recommends MCP servers during agent building. Strale's existing MCP server ([api.strale.io/mcp](http://api.strale.io/mcp)) is technically compatible — Agentforce connects to remote MCP servers via HTTPS. Natural fit: Agentforce sales/service agents doing lead qualification, vendor assessment, KYB — all need counterparty verification, sanctions screening, domain reputation. **Barriers:** Current partners are large enterprises; listing requires partnership relationship with Salesforce (not self-service). Customer base is enterprise admins (low-code), not developers. Significant BD overhead for a solo founder pre-traction. **Trigger to act:** When AgentExchange opens to smaller ISV partners, or when Strale has 10+ active users for social proof. Research: chat session 2026-04-02.
